proposed_title: Gaza humanitarian classification: dated WHO claim, current state unverified
what_happened: WHO exact statement dated 22 August 2025 was freshly retrieved. It is retained as a dated official humanitarian claim, not misrepresented as a 2026 situation update.
key_facts: OFFICIAL_CLAIM: WHO reported an IPC famine confirmation for specified Gaza areas at publication time.
UNKNOWN: casualty totals, territorial coverage, aid access and classification on 2 September 2026 were not verified.
FACT: the source date is 2025-08-22, not today.

primary_sources.claim_supported: WHO/IPC famine classification and health warning for Gaza at publication date
primary_sources.independence: UN health body statement; attribution retained, not treated as same-day 2026 status

contradictory_evidence: Humanitarian classifications are time- and area-specific.
No opposing or independent current source was retrieved in this narrow check.
uncertainty: High for what WHO published in 2025; no confidence assigned to a 2026 status.
context: Palestine rules require fact/claim/disputed/estimate/unknown separation and explicit provenance.
why_it_matters: Prevents a dated humanitarian statement from becoming a false current ticker.
strategic_angle: HOLD until a current OCHA/IPC document plus independent reporting and relevant party claims are retrieved.
